activation.note: Activation covers new and existing in-scope trains, including review without edits, consistently with the unconditional source invariant. Task terms are explicitly secondary rather than sufficient triggers; diff-level observation is marked as requiring a new observer. Exclusions concern work with no train in scope.

audit.summary: All 17 segments survive at their claimed destinations, with all seven validation requirements available to the coder, including category values and the prohibition on digit-encoded category. The single obligation is structural validity; activation and rationale additions are declared, and there are no waivers or shared-node moves.

segmentChecks.note: The then clause retains the unconditional requirement and enumerates all seven checks; given/when correctly scope it to new or existing trains being authored, edited, reviewed, or validated.
The exact train:{subject}:{slug} pattern appears in prefer[0], with the same requirement in then and evidence.
The separate category field, all four allowed values, and the ban on encoding category as an identity digit are explicit in prefer[1] and avoid[1].
Prefer[2] requires existence at the declared path and gives corrective actions without weakening the obligation.
Prefer[3] and evidence[3] require every referenced participant to appear in the participants list.
Prefer[4] requires every dependency to point to an existing, valid train_id; evidence[4] states the equivalent resolution check.
Every sequence artifact must use domain:resource form, as stated in prefer[5], avoid[4], and evidence[5].
Prefer[6] and evidence[6] require every used theme to be declared in the themes array.
The definition of validation_rule is reproduced verbatim in verifier_detail[0] and audit.

risks: The grammars for {subject}, {slug}, domain, and resource are not defined, so a weak planner could implement only colon-count checks or invent incompatible character restrictions when validating malformed components.

unobservable: change: the diff-level values train added, train file modified, and existing train in scope for validation are explicitly marked needs_new_observer; this is optional because file_kind is the primary activation signal.

review.summary: The rewrite preserves all source obligations, including every enumerated constraint and the category prohibition, and the auditor's PASS is justified. Activation is deterministic from observable file kind with the optional change signal honestly marked as needing an observer; the only notable usability gap is the inherited lack of token grammars for the naming patterns.
